images.filename: City parish churches, St. Bartholomew the Great - geograph.org.uk - 559809.jpg
images.caption: City parish churches: St. Bartholomew the Great St. Bartholomew the Great was originally founded as an Augustinian abbey in 1123. It was partially demolished in 1543 and survived the Great Fire of 1666. However, it fell into disrepair before being restored in the late 19th century.
images.alt: City parish churches: St. Bartholomew the Great St. Bartholomew the Great was originally founded as an Augustinian abbey in 1123. It was partially demolished in 1543 and survived the Great Fire of 1666. However, it fell into disrepair before being restored in the late 19th century.

images.filename: Great St Barts - porch (15273092836).jpg
images.caption:
The relatively recent porch of the Church of St Bartholomew the Great, in West Smithfield. Porch architect: Sir Aston Webb, 1893, made of Portland stone and knapped flint. The carved figure is of Prior Rahere who founded the priory in 1123 and was buried here in 1143. City of London.

(CC-by-SA - credit: Photo by George Rex.)
images.alt:
The relatively recent porch of the Church of St Bartholomew the Great, in West Smithfield. Porch architect: Sir Aston Webb, 1893, made of Portland stone and knapped flint. The carved figure is of Prior Rahere who founded the priory in 1123 and was buried here in 1143. City of London.

(CC-by-SA - credit: Photo by George Rex.)
